name: RIM-116 Rolling Airframe Missile
description: Short-range ship self-defence missile — the inner missile layer between the SM/ESSM area SAMs and the CIWS gun. Passive IR terminal homing (real RAM is dual-mode RF/IR); spins in flight for stability. Cheap, fast, high-G, carried in big 21-cell launchers to soak a saturation raid of sea-skimming anti-ship missiles. ~9 km effective. Visual stand-in: Sidewinder body.
